title: Hungry girl smacks his milk, his reaction is gold
caption:
POV: she's still hungry and your milk is in danger
She demolished her plate in seconds, then went straight for his glass mid-sip.
No arguing, no drama - he just smiled, said alright I get it, and slid her the menu.
Whose side are you on: team hungry girl or team protect the milk?
Save this for the hangry friend in your life.
#relatable #animatedshort #chibi #storytime #fruit_drama_tv
